title: bundle_index.v1
description: One descriptor per sealed artifact role, pointing to a content-addressed blob. Required roles are fixed independently by the caller or verifier and never inferred from this index.

descriptor.description: One sealed artifact: the role it fills, its declared media type, its content digest, and its byte size.

role.description: The artifact's role in the bundle (e.g. "receipt"). Unique within descriptors.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the artifact's bytes.

digest.description: sha256 content digest of the artifact's bytes (underwrite_core.canonical.digest_bytes), OCI style.

size.description: Byte length of the artifact's data.
